chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Sālim, from Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr, from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: Tell me, if one takbīrah or more escapes me, what do you think? He said: You make up what you missed. I said: Should I face the qiblah? He said: Yes, while you are following the جنازة. For the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم came to the funeral of a woman from Banū al-Najjār and performed salat over her. Then he found that the grave-pit had not yet been prepared for them, so they placed the جنازة down, and no group came except that he said to them: Perform salat over her.

key_terms.الْجَنَازَةَ: the funeral bier or deceased over whom salat is performed
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction one faces in worship
key_terms.تَقْضِي: you make up or complete what was missed
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةٌ: a single takbīr in the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Can missed takbīrs in salat al-janāzah be made up, and may the funeral prayer be performed more than once?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of making up missed takbīrs in salat over the dead and indicates that one should face the qiblah while following the جنازة. It also cites the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, who allowed repeated salat over a جنازة as new groups arrived.
